comment: No source is published. THE LOW-PASS FILTER IS SHUT BY DEFAULT. The module configures parameter 7, the knob the panel prints LPF, from 0 to 1 with a default of 0. It is turned into a filter coefficient of 0.1 times the cube of 0.9 times the knob plus 0.1, so a knob at 0 gives 0.0001 and a knob at 1 gives 0.1. The filter is applied on every sub-sample with no bypass, so at the default the corner is far below the audio band and the module is effectively silent until LPF is raised. The HPF knob, parameter 6, is squared and scaled by 0.1 and is genuinely out of the path at 0. Index order is not panel order for these two: parameter 7 (LPF) sits above parameter 6 (HPF) on the panel, at census positions 90,270 and 90,300, and they are tagged accordingly. Neither filter has a CV jack. The noise source is a fresh rand() value taken thirty-two times per oscillator cycle, so it is pitched rather than white. The pitch bend multiplies the oscillator period once per sample by one plus a hundredth of the cube of the setting, and the period is held between 8 and 400000 samples. Panel lettering came from https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/DigitalAtavism/Hit.png; the plugin ships no panel SVG.
